features.name: Európa lakókert
features.evidence: Contemporary 2004 reports identify these four boundary streets; developer confirms 1.5ha and 205 dwellings delivered 2005. Official area is small actual estate; Openalfa name areas appear broader.

features.name: Szent György-telep
features.evidence: XVI district official newspaper local history lists these historical bounds.

features.name: Kisszentmihály
features.evidence: Same district source lists historical extent and anticipated move from Timur to Csömöri út. Treat historical extent explicitly; no alias to entire Árpádföld.

features.name: Óhegyi lakótelep
features.evidence: X district regulation 12/2013, Annex2 G categorizes these streets as Óhegyi lakótelep. Outer ring can follow street fabric around this actual estate. Source separately categorizes Szőlőhegy and other Harmat estates; do not broaden to listing-mislabeled blocks.

features.name: Honfoglalás lakópark
features.evidence: Official newspaper says nine new streets created within the built estate at Árpádföld/Cinkota border. 2022 regulation identifies playground and sports parcel Etelköz utca 118736/156.

features.name: Ilonatelep
features.evidence: Official district-history 2013 source says south of Szabadföld út and east of Gazdaság út. 2015 says between Gazdaságút and cemetery. Southern closure not established by text; trace actual estate/parcel edge if available.

features.name: EcoLiget lakópark
features.evidence: Municipal council minutes identify project on XI Alsóhatár utca 1151/5 parcel; XI planning assessment lists Alsóhatár5. Listing says five three-storey buildings. Need source surface/parcel or manual footprint ring, not radius from address.

features.name: Királyhágó lakópark
features.evidence: Local museum locates Királyhágó estate on former sports fields along Királyhágó street front; distinguishes later 2010s Tarkő/Kétújfalu development. Developer reference confirms Királyhágó4 at81 on nearly1ha parcel. Official TM5 bounds refer to broader multi-estate area and should not be equated with this name. Királyhágó73 is Magnólia estate in official health district list.

features.name: Szabadságtelep
features.evidence: City history identifies annexation from Csömör; public map street membership at Suba/Csűr/Csitári gives anchors but no complete official perimeter found. Do not equate to whole Árpádföld.

unresolved: Four named roads need actual geometry joining for Európa and Szent György.
Ilonatelep southern extent needs parcel or road-fabric tracing.
